feed.title: How much should my pet eat?
feed.intro: Two quick steps. The results update as you type.
feed.disclaimer: This is an estimate. Every animal is different. Check your pet’s weight and body shape often, and ask your vet before big changes.

step1.title: Daily calorie needs
step1.subtitle: Find out how many calories your pet needs each day.
step1.weightError: Please type a number, like 12 or 4.5
step1.idealNote: For weight loss or gain, type the **ideal** weight, not the current weight.
step1.emptyBoth: Type the weight and pick one option above.

step2.title: Daily food amount
step2.subtitle: Turn calories into grams of your pet's food.
step2.energyHelp: Look on the food label for “Calorie content” and use the **kcal/kg** number.
step2.energyLowWarn: This number looks small for kcal per kg. Check that the label says kcal/kg, not kcal per cup or per can.
step2.perMeal: = **{grams} g** per meal, {meals} meals a day
step2.resultSub: For {kcal} kcal per day, food with {density} kcal/kg
step2.emptyStep1: Finish step 1, then type the kcal/kg from the label.
step2.emptyEnergy: Type the kcal/kg from the food label.

kgPerDay.title: Divide the energy need by the energy in the food
